episodes.synopsis: A leading member of the Sorcerer Shogun, Yngwie von Mattström conquers one city after another. Meanwhile, samurai masters try to secure food supplies.
episodes.title: Rebellion

episodes.synopsis: Samurai centurion Jorg Fishes faces off against Sorcerer Shogun Macapine Toni Strauss. Kall-Su reveals his sinister plans to rule the world.
episodes.title: Fate

episodes.synopsis: The samurai corps brace themselves for the upcoming invasion. With no hope in sight, Yoko attempts a spell that comes at a heavy price.
episodes.title: Blue Storm

episodes.synopsis: The tables turn when a powerful ally makes a sudden appearance. Later, a defeated Macapine Toni Strauss lands in front of an unlikely survivor.
episodes.title: Dawn

episodes.synopsis: Di-amon barges into Kall-Su's castle and stirs chaos. As Kall-Su's powers grow uncannily strong, Shella E,Lee notices that something is off.
episodes.title: Ice and Snow

episodes.synopsis: Kall-Su tasks demi-humans to deal with rioters, while he has grander plans for his Sorcerer Shoguns. Yoko deals with an untamed Dark Schneider.
episodes.title: Departure

episodes.synopsis: Yoko and crew learn about Kall-Su's sinister plans. Later, they are called to the basement of the castle and discover an ancient artifact.
episodes.title: Teleportation

episodes.synopsis: Left in the castle, Shella E, Lee learns the shocking truth. The Sorcerer Shogun experience unexpected turbulence on their way to King Crimson Glory.
episodes.title: Magic Land

episodes.synopsis: A young village boy listens to a bedtime story about the civilization that created Anthrasax. Meanwhile, Yoko and crew land in King Crimson Glory.
episodes.title: Legend

episodes.synopsis: Bol Gil Bol faces off against Dark Schneider. Gara and Macapine Toni Strauss face a threat. Arshes Nei dreams of her past.
episodes.title: Distant Thunder

episodes.synopsis: When a formidable opponent makes a sudden appearance, the samurai corps have a change of heart about Dark Schneider. Sheila finds herself in danger.
episodes.title: Holy War I

episodes.synopsis: A fierce showdown between the samurai corps and Sorcerer Shogun takes place. Kall-Su gets dangerously close to unlocking the final seal.
episodes.title: Holy War II

episodes.synopsis: Sheila experiences a sudden change in condition. Kall-Su and Dark Schneider unleash an epic battle of ice versus fire.
episodes.title: Holy War III

episodes.synopsis: United over a common enemy, the samurai corps inspire the grieving Sorcerer Shogun with their unwavering spirit.
episodes.title: Holy War IV

episodes.synopsis: Unconscious within the beast, Kall-Su has flashbacks to his past. Determined to save his friend, Dark Schneider wields majestic powers like no other.
episodes.title: Gathering
